std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n612\t            if (i == j) continue;\n613\t            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n614\t                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n719\t    }\n720\t\n721\t    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n722\t    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist /    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n727\t    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n728\t        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n729\t    }\n730\t\n731\t    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n732\t    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n733\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n734\t    }\n739\t        }\n740\t    }\n741\t\n742\t    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n743\t\n744\t    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n745\t        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n746\t        return false;\n747\t    }\n748\t\n749\t    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n750\t    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n751\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n752\t        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n753\t    }\n754\t    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n755\t           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n756\t           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n757\t\n758\t    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n759\t        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n760\t        return false;\n761\t    }\n762\t\n763\t    if (!allNonNegative) {\n764\t        return false;\n765\t    }\n766\t\n767\t    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768\t    return true;\n769\t}\n770\t\n771\t// Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y :   std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return = static_cast<int>(leafTris.size());\n    d.triCount = static_cast<int>(n.triangleIndices.size());\n    for (size_t idx : n.triangleIndices) leafTris.push_back(static_cast<int>(idx));\n    for (int i 1, maxDepth);\n        }\n    }\n    nodes[me] = d;\n    return me;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDev(const DevOctNode& nd, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - Vec3(nd.cx, nd.cy, nd.cz);\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > nd.hx + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > nd.hy + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > nd.hz + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > nd.hy * ad.z + nd.hz * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > nd.hz * ad.x + nd.hx * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > nd.hx * ad.y + nd.hy * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated, device)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const DevOctNode* nodes, const int* leafTris,\n                             const Triangle* tris, int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[MAX_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const DevOctNode& nd = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (nd.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < nd.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = leafTris[nd.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = tris[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int i = 7; i >= 0; --i) {\n                int c = nd.child[i];\n                if (c >= 0 && rayIntersectsBoxDev(nodes[c], from, to)) stack[sp++] = c;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nHD val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n__device__ val_t computeKij(int idxI, int idxJ, int N,\n                            const Triangle* triangles,\n                            const DevOctNode* nodes, const int* leafTris) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    RandomGenerator rng(42, static_cast<uint64_t>(idxI) * static_cast<uint64_t>(N) + idxJ);\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, leafTris, triangles, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ int computeTau(const Vec3& ci, const Vec3& cj) {\n    val_t dist = (ci - cj).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Combined propagation table entry: weight = min(Kij * area_j, 1) (0 if Kij <= 0), and delay\nstruct SimEntry {\n    val_t w;\n    int tau;\n};\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<Vec3> centers;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (all triangles)\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure (host build)\n\n    // MPI decomposition: rank r owns rows i = k * nranks + r\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nranks = 1;\n    size_t nLocal = 0;              // rows owned by this rank\n    size_t maxLocal = 0;            // max rows owned by any rank\n\n    // Validation statistics (globally reduced)\n    long long nonZeroKij = 0;\n    long long receivedEnergy = 0;\n\n    // Device data\n    Triangle* d_tris = nullptr;\n    Vec3* d_centers = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_areas = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_rho = nullptr;\n    DevOctNode* d_nodes = nullptr;\n    int* d_leafTris = nullptr;\n    SimEntry* d_table = nullptr;    // nLocal x N\n    val_t* d_radB = nullptr;        // T x N (replicated on every rank)\n\n    size_t globalRow(size_t k) const { return k * static_cast<size_t>(nranks) + static_cast<size_t>(rank); }\n};\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nstatic T* deviceAlloc(size_t count) {\n    T* p = nullptr;\n    if (count == 0) count = 1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&p, count * sizeof(T)));\n    return p;\n}\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nstatic T* deviceUpload(const std::vector<T>& v) {\n    T* p = deviceAlloc<T>(v.size());\n    if (!v.empty()) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(p, v.data(), v.size() * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    return p;\n}\n\nstatic void releaseDevice(SimulationState& s) {\n    cudaFree(s.d_tris); cudaFree(s.d_centers); cudaFree(s.d_areas); cudaFree(s.d_rho);\n    cudaFree(s.d_nodes); cudaFree(s.d_leafTris); cudaFree(s.d_table); cudaFree(s.d_radB);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", N);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas / centers\n    state.areas.resize(N);\n    state.centers.resize(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n        state.centers[i] = state.triangles[i].center();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.assign(N, reflectivity);\n    state.distances.assign(N, ZERO);\n\n    // Row decomposition\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(state.nranks);\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(state.rank);\n    state.nLocal = (N > r) ? (N - r + P - 1) / P : 0;\n    state.maxLocal = (N + P - 1) / P;\n\n    // Flatten octree and upload everything to the GPU\n    std::vector<DevOctNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<int> leafTris;\n    int maxDepth = 0;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, nodes, leafTris, 0, maxDepth);\n    if (maxDepth >= MAX_OCTREE_DEPTH) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep for device traversal stack (%d)\\n\", maxDepth);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    state.d_tris = deviceUpload(state.triangles);\n    state.d_centers = deviceUpload(state.centers);\n    state.d_areas = deviceUpload(state.areas);\n    state.d_rho = deviceUpload(state.rho);\n    state.d_nodes = deviceUpload(nodes);\n    state.d_leafTris = deviceUpload(leafTris);\n\n    size_t tableBytes = state.nLocal * N * sizeof(SimEntry);\n    size_t freeB = 0, totalB = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeB, &totalB));\n    if (tableBytes + timesteps * N * sizeof(val_t) > freeB) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d: not enough GPU memory (need %.2f GB, free %.2f GB); use more ranks\\n\",\n                state.rank, (tableBytes + timesteps * N * sizeof(val_t)) / 1e9, freeB / 1e9);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    state.d_table = deviceAlloc<SimEntry>(state.nLocal * N);\n    state.d_radB = deviceAlloc<val_t>(timesteps * N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_radB, 0, std::max<size_t>(timesteps * N, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per (local row, column) pair; computes Kij and Tau and stores the\n// propagation weight and delay.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(const Triangle* tris, const Vec3* centers, const val_t* areas,\n                                 const DevOctNode* nodes, const int* leafTris,\n                                 int N, int P, int rank, size_t rowBegin, size_t rowEnd,\n                                 SimEntry* table, unsigned long long* nonZeroCount) {\n    __shared__ unsigned int blockNz;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) blockNz = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    size_t pairs = (rowEnd - rowBegin) * static_cast<size_t>(N);\n    size_t g = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (g < pairs) {\n        size_t k = rowBegin + g / N;\n        int j = static_cast<int>(g % N);\n        int i = static_cast<int>(k * P + rank);\n\n        SimEntry e;\n        e.w = ZERO;\n        e.tau = 0;\n        if (i != j) {\n            e.tau = computeTau(centers[i], centers[j]);\n            val_t kij = computeKij(i, j, N, tris, nodes, leafTris);\n            if (kij > EPSILON) atomicAdd(&blockNz, 1u);\n            if (kij > ZERO) e.w = fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE);\n        }\n        table[k * N + j] = e;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0 && blockNz) atomicAdd(nonZeroCount, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockNz));\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau) and form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    unsigned long long* d_nz = deviceAlloc<unsigned long long>(1);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_nz, 0, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n\n    const int threads = 128;\n    const size_t rowsPerChunk = std::max<size_t>(1, (size_t(1) << 22) / N);\n    for (size_t r0 = 0; r0 < state.nLocal; r0 += rowsPerChunk) {\n        size_t r1 = std::min(state.nLocal, r0 + rowsPerChunk);\n        size_t pairs = (r1 - r0) * N;\n        size_t blocks = (pairs + threads - 1) / threads;\n        formFactorKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blocks), threads>>>(\n            state.d_tris, state.d_centers, state.d_areas, state.d_nodes, state.d_leafTris,\n            static_cast<int>(N), state.nranks, state.rank, r0, r1, state.d_table, d_nz);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    unsigned long long localNz = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&localNz, d_nz, sizeof(localNz), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    cudaFree(d_nz);\n    long long gl = static_cast<long long>(localNz);\n    MPI_Allreduce(&gl, &state.nonZeroKij, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", N, N);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One warp per owned row; lanes stride over the columns j.\n__global__ void propagateKernel(const SimEntry* table, const val_t* radB, const val_t* rho,\n                                val_t* out, int N, int nLocal, int P, int rank,\n                                int t, int sourceIdx, bool emitting) {\n    int warp = static_cast<int>((static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) >> 5);\n    int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    if (warp >= nLocal) return;\n\n    const SimEntry* row = table + static_cast<size_t>(warp) * N;\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    for (int j = lane; j < N; j += 32) {\n        SimEntry e = row[j];\n        if (e.w <= ZERO || t < e.tau) continue;\n        val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - e.tau) * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n        sumB += e.w * radJ;\n    }\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sumB += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sumB, off);\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        int i = warp * P + rank;\n        val_t emit = (emitting && i == sourceIdx) ? ONE : ZERO;\n        out[warp] = rho[i] * sumB + emit;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(state.nranks);\n    const size_t timeOff = state.numTimesteps / 2;\n\n    val_t* d_out = deviceAlloc<val_t>(state.maxLocal);\n    std::vector<val_t> sendBuf(state.maxLocal, ZERO);\n    std::vector<val_t> recvBuf(state.maxLocal * P, ZERO);\n    std::vector<val_t> row(N, ZERO);\n\n    const int threads = 128;\n    const int warpsPerBlock = threads / 32;\n    unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>((state.nLocal + warpsPerBlock - 1) / warpsPerBlock);\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        if (blocks > 0) {\n            propagateKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(state.d_table, state.d_radB, state.d_rho, d_out,\n                                                 static_cast<int>(N), static_cast<int>(state.nLocal),\n                                                 state.nranks, state.rank, static_cast<int>(t),\n                                                 static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex), t < timeOff);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(sendBuf.data(), d_out, state.nLocal * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        // Exchange this timestep's radiosity row between all ranks\n        MPI_Allgather(sendBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(state.maxLocal), MPI_FLOAT,\n                      recvBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(state.maxLocal), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            row[i] = recvBuf[(i % P) * state.maxLocal + i / P];\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_radB + t * N, row.data(), N * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n    cudaFree(d_out);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Gather the time series (column) of each owned triangle and of the source.\n__global__ void extractColumnsKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* cols, val_t* srcCol,\n                                     int N, int T, int nLocal, int P, int rank, int sourceIdx) {\n    size_t g = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(nLocal) * T;\n    if (g < total) {\n        int t = static_cast<int>(g % T);\n        int k = static_cast<int>(g / T);\n        cols[g] = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + static_cast<size_t>(k) * P + rank];\n    }\n    if (g < static_cast<size_t>(T)) srcCol[g] = radB[g * N + sourceIdx];\n}\n\n// One block per owned triangle; threads stride over lags. Summation order per lag\n// matches the sequential algorithm; ties resolve to the smallest lag.\n__global__ void crossCorrelationKernel(const val_t* cols, const val_t* srcCol, int T,\n                                       val_t* dist, int* gotEnergy) {\n    __shared__ val_t sVal[256];\n    __shared__ int sLag[256];\n    const val_t* pB = cols + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * T;\n\n    val_t best = ZERO;\n    int bestT = INT_MAX;\n    int energy = 0;\n    for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < T; t += blockDim.x) {\n        if (pB[t] > EPSILON) energy = 1;\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) sum += srcCol[tt - t] * pB[tt];\n        if (sum > best) {\n            best = sum;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    int anyEnergy = __syncthreads_or(energy);\n\n    sVal[threadIdx.x] = best;\n    sLag[threadIdx.x] = bestT;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < s) {\n            val_t ov = sVal[threadIdx.x + s];\n            int ol = sLag[threadIdx.x + s];\n            if (ov > sVal[threadIdx.x] || (ov == sVal[threadIdx.x] && ol < sLag[threadIdx.x])) {\n                sVal[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                sLag[threadIdx.x] = ol;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        int lag = (sLag[0] == INT_MAX) ? 0 : sLag[0];\n        dist[blockIdx.x] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(lag);\n        gotEnergy[blockIdx.x] = anyEnergy;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(state.nranks);\n\n    std::vector<val_t> sendBuf(state.maxLocal, ZERO);\n    std::vector<int> energyLocal(std::max<size_t>(state.nLocal, 1), 0);\n\n    if (state.nLocal > 0 && T > 0) {\n        val_t* d_cols = deviceAlloc<val_t>(state.nLocal * T);\n        val_t* d_src = deviceAlloc<val_t>(T);\n        val_t* d_dist = deviceAlloc<val_t>(state.nLocal);\n        int* d_energy = deviceAlloc<int>(state.nLocal);\n\n        size_t total = std::max(state.nLocal * T, T);\n        extractColumnsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>((total + 255) / 256), 256>>>(\n            state.d_radB, d_cols, d_src, static_cast<int>(N), static_cast<int>(T),\n            static_cast<int>(state.nLocal), state.nranks, state.rank, static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex));\n        crossCorrelationKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.nLocal), 256>>>(\n            d_cols, d_src, static_cast<int>(T), d_dist, d_energy);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(sendBuf.data(), d_dist, state.nLocal * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(energyLocal.data(), d_energy, state.nLocal * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        cudaFree(d_cols); cudaFree(d_src); cudaFree(d_dist); cudaFree(d_energy);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<val_t> recvBuf(state.maxLocal * P, ZERO);\n    MPI_Allgather(sendBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(state.maxLocal), MPI_FLOAT,\n                  recvBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(state.maxLocal), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.distances[i] = recvBuf[(i % P) * state.maxLocal + i / P];\n    }\n\n    long long localEnergy = 0;\n    if (T > 0) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < state.nLocal; ++k) localEnergy += energyLocal[k];\n    }\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localEnergy, &state.receivedEnergy, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %lld/%zu\\n\", state.receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (state.receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    size_t total = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %lld/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           state.nonZeroKij, total,\n           100.0f * state.nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(total));\n\n    if (state.nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(^ : hash) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        uint32_t bits;\n        memcpy(&bits, &state.distances[i], sizeof(bits));\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(bits) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n computes Kij and Tau and stores the\n// propagation weight and delay.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(const Triangle* tris, const Vec3* centers, const val_t* areas,\n                                 const DevOctNode* nodes, const int* leafTris,\n                                 int N, int P, int rank, size_t rowBegin, size_t rowEnd,\n                                 SimEntry* table, unsigned long long* nonZeroCount) {\n    __shared__ unsigned int blockNz;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) blockNz = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    size_t pairs = (rowEnd - rowBegin) * static_cast<size_t>(N);\n    size_t g = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (g < pairs) {\n        size_t k = rowBegin + g / N;\n        int j = static_cast<int>(g % N);\n        int i = static_cast<int>(k * P + rank);\n\n        SimEntry e;\n        e.w = ZERO;\n        e.tau = 0;\n        if (i != j) {\n            e.tau = computeTau(centers[i], centers[j]);\n            val_t kij = computeKij(i, j, N, tris, nodes, leafTris);\n            if (kij > EPSILON) atomicAdd(&blockNz, 1u);\n            if (kij > ZERO) e.w = fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE);\n        }\n        table[k * N + j] = e;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0 && blockNz) atomicAdd(nonZeroCount, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockNz));\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau) and form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    unsigned long long* d_nz = deviceAlloc<unsigned long long>(1);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_nz, 0, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n\n    const int threads = 128;\n    const size_t rowsPerChunk = std::max<size_t>(1, (size_t(1) << 22) / N);\n    for (size_t r0 = 0; r0 < state.nLocal; r0 += rowsPerChunk) {\n        size_t r1 = std::min(state.nLocal, r0 + rowsPerChunk);\n        size_t pairs = (r1 - r0) * N;\n        size_t blocks = (pairs + threads - 1) / threads;\n        formFactorKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blocks), threads>>>(\n            state.d_tris, state.d_centers, state.d_areas, state.d_nodes, state.d_leafTris,\n            static_cast<int>(N), state.nranks, state.rank, r0, r1, state.d_table, d_nz);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    unsigned long long localNz = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&localNz, d_nz, sizeof(localNz), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    cudaFree(d_nz);\n    long long gl = static_cast<long long>(localNz);\n    MPI_Allreduce(&gl, &state.nonZeroKij, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", N, N);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One warp per owned row; lanes stride over the columns j.\n__global__ void propagateKernel(const SimEntry* table, const val_t* radB, const val_t* rho,\n                                val_t* out, int N, int nLocal, int P, int rank,\n                                int t, int sourceIdx, bool emitting) {\n    int warp = static_cast<int>((static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) >> 5);\n    int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    if (warp >= nLocal) return;\n\n    const SimEntry* row = table + static_cast<size_t>(warp) * N;\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    for (int j = lane; j < N; j += 32) {\n        SimEntry e = row[j];\n        if (e.w <= ZERO || t < e.tau) continue;\n        val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - e.tau) * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n        sumB += e.w * radJ;\n    }\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sumB += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sumB, off);\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        int i = warp * P + rank;\n        val_t emit = (emitting && i == sourceIdx) ? ONE : ZERO;\n        out[warp] = rho[i] * sumB + emit;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(state.nranks);\n    const size_t timeOff = state.numTimesteps / 2;\n\n    val_t* d_out = deviceAlloc<val_t>(state.maxLocal);\n    std::vector<val_t> sendBuf(state.maxLocal, ZERO);\n    std::vector<val_t> recvBuf(state.maxLocal * P, ZERO);\n    std::vector<val_t> row(N, ZERO);\n\n    const int threads = 128;\n    const int warpsPerBlock = threads / 32;\n    unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>((state.nLocal + warpsPerBlock - 1) / warpsPerBlock);\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        if (blocks > 0) {\n            propagateKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(state.d_table, state.d_radB, state.d_rho, d_out,\n                                                 static_cast<int>(N), static_cast<int>(state.nLocal),\n                                                 state.nranks, state.rank, static_cast<int>(t),\n                                                 static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex), t < timeOff);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(sendBuf.data(), d_out, state.nLocal * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        // Exchange this timestep's radiosity row between all ranks\n        MPI_Allgather(sendBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(state.maxLocal), MPI_FLOAT,\n                      recvBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(state.maxLocal), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            row[i] = recvBuf[(i % P) * state.maxLocal + i / P];\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_radB + t * N, row.data(), N * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n    cudaFree(d_out);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Gather the time series (column) of each owned triangle and of the source.\n__global__ void extractColumnsKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* cols, val_t* srcCol,\n                                     int N, int T, int nLocal, int P, int rank, int sourceIdx) {\n    size_t g = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(nLocal) * T;\n    if (g < total) {\n        int t = static_cast<int>(g % T);\n        int k = static_cast<int>(g / T);\n        cols[g] = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + static_cast<size_t>(k) * P + rank];\n    }\n    if (g < static_cast<size_t>(T)) srcCol[g] = radB[g * N + sourceIdx];\n}\n\n// One block per owned triangle; threads stride over lags. Summation order per lag\n// matches the sequential algorithm; ties resolve to the smallest lag.\n__global__ void crossCorrelationKernel(const val_t* cols, const val_t* srcCol, int T,\n                                       val_t* dist, int* gotEnergy) {\n    __shared__ val_t sVal[256];\n    __shared__ int sLag[256];\n    const val_t* pB = cols + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * T;\n\n    val_t best = ZERO;\n    int bestT = INT_MAX;\n    int energy = 0;\n    for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < T; t += blockDim.x) {\n        if (pB[t] > EPSILON) energy = 1;\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) sum += srcCol[tt - t] * pB[tt];\n        if (sum > best) {\n            best = sum;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    int anyEnergy = __syncthreads_or(energy);\n\n    sVal[threadIdx.x] = best;\n    sLag[threadIdx.x] = bestT;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < s) {\n            val_t ov = sVal[threadIdx.x + s];\n            int ol = sLag[threadIdx.x + s];\n            if (ov > sVal[threadIdx.x] || (ov == sVal[threadIdx.x] && ol < sLag[threadIdx.x])) {\n                sVal[threadIdx.x] = ov;\n                sLag[threadIdx.x] = ol;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        int lag = (sLag[0] == INT_MAX) ? 0 : sLag[0];\n        dist[blockIdx.x] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(lag);\n        gotEnergy[blockIdx.x] = anyEnergy;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(state.nranks);\n\n    std::vector<val_t> sendBuf(state.maxLocal, ZERO);\n    std::vector<int> energyLocal(std::max<size_t>(state.nLocal, 1), 0);\n\n    if (state.nLocal > 0 && T > 0) {\n        val_t* d_cols = deviceAlloc<val_t>(state.nLocal * T);\n        val_t* d_src = deviceAlloc<val_t>(T);\n        val_t* d_dist = deviceAlloc<val_t>(state.nLocal);\n        int* d_energy = deviceAlloc<int>(state.nLocal);\n\n        size_t total = std::max(state.nLocal * T, T);\n        extractColumnsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>((total + 255) / 256), 256>>>(\n            state.d_radB, d_cols, d_src, static_cast<int>(N), static_cast<int>(T),\n            static_cast<int>(state.nLocal), state.nranks, state.rank, static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex));\n        crossCorrelationKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.nLocal), 256>>>(\n            d_cols, d_src, static_cast<int>(T), d_dist, d_energy);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(sendBuf.data(), d_dist, state.nLocal * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(energyLocal.data(), d_energy, state.nLocal * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        cudaFree(d_cols); cudaFree(d_src); cudaFree(d_dist); cudaFree(d_energy);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<val_t> recvBuf(state.maxLocal * P, ZERO);\n    MPI_Allgather(sendBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(state.maxLocal), MPI_FLOAT,\n                  recvBuf.data(), static_cast<int>(state.maxLocal), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.distances[i] = recvBuf[(i % P) * state.maxLocal + i / P];\n    }\n\n    long long localEnergy = 0;\n    if (T > 0) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < state.nLocal; ++k) localEnergy += energyLocal[k];\n    }\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localEnergy, &state.receivedEnergy, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %lld/%zu\\n\", state.receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (state.receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    size_t total = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %lld/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           state.nonZeroKij, total,\n           100.0f * state.nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(total));\n\n    if (state.nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(^ : hash) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        uint32_t bits;\n        memcpy(&bits, &state.distances[i], sizeof(bits));\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(bits) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nstatic long elapsedMs(double t0, double t1) {\n    return static_cast<long>((t1 - t0) * 1000.0);\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    SimulationState state;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &state.rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &state.nranks);\n\n    // Only rank 0 writes to stdout\n    if (state.rank != 0) {\n        if (!freopen(\"/dev/null\", \"w\", stdout)) return 1;\n    }\n\n    // One GPU per rank (round-robin over the GPUs visible on the node)\n    {\n        MPI_Comm local;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, state.rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local);\n        int localRank = 0;\n        MPI_Comm_rank(local, &localRank);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&local);\n        int numDevices = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&numDevices));\n        if (numDevices == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices found\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % numDevices));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));\n    }\n\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    printf(\"Parallelization: %d MPI ranks x %d OpenMP threads, CUDA\\n\", state.nranks, omp_get_max_threads());\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    double startPre = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    computeFormFactors(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    double endPre = MPI_Wtime();\n    long preDuration = elapsedMs(startPre, endPre);\n\n    printf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Simulation\n    double startSim = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    runSimulation(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    double endSim = MPI_Wtime();\n    long simDuration = elapsedMs(startSim, endSim);\n\n    printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", simDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Distance computation\n    double startDist = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    computeDistances(state);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    double endDist = MPI_Wtime();\n    long distDuration = elapsedMs(startDist, endDist);\n\n    printf(\"Distance computation time: %ld ms\\n\", distDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Total time\n    long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;\n    printf(\"Total computation time: %ld ms\\n\", totalTime);\n\n    // Performance metrics\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n    double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n * n);\n    double simOps = static_cast<double>(n * n * t);\n    double distOps = static_cast<double>(n * t * t);\n\n    printf(\"\\nPerformance:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Triangles: %zu\\n\", n);\n    printf(\"  Timesteps: %zu\\n\", t);\n    printf(\"  Form factor computations: %.2e\\n\", kijOps);\n    printf(\"  Simulation operations: %.2e\\n\", simOps);\n    printf(\"  Distance computations: %.2e\\n\", distOps);\n    printf(\"  Total time per triangle: %.4f ms\\n\", static_cast<double>(totalTime) / n);\n\n    // Memory usage\n    size_t memKij = n * n * sizeof(val_t);\n    size_t memTau = n * n * sizeof(int);\n    size_t memRad = 2 * t * n * sizeof(val_t);\n    size_t totalMem = memKij + memTau + memRad;\n    printf(\"  Memory usage: %.2f MB\\n\", totalMem / (1024.0 * 1024.0));\n\n    // Hash\n    uint64_t hash = computeHash(state);\n    printf(\"  Result hash: %016lX\\n\", hash);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Convert distances to double for output\n        std::vector<double> distData(state.distances.begin(), state.distances.end());\n        print_results(distData, \"Distances\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    int status = 0;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (!validateResults(state)) {\n            status = 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg31zj9j63kCPL74afUy6","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"`roomsim` is now parallelized with MPI, OpenMP and CUDA, and it builds and runs. Its results matched the original in three of the four cases I compared. I edited only `roomsim.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` and kept the executable name.\n\n**Parallelization**\n- **MPI:** Each rank owns every P-th triangle row and uses one GPU, chosen by node-local rank. Each rank holds only its slice of the Kij and delay table. Each timestep's radiosity row is shared with `MPI_Allgather`, and distances are gathered the same way. Only rank 0 prints.\n- **CUDA:** There are four kernels:\n  - Form factors and delays: one thread per triangle pair, with an iterative ray test over a flattened octree.\n  - Propagation: one warp per row.\n  - Time-series extraction.\n  - Cross-correlation: one block per triangle. The summation order matches the original and ties go to the smallest lag.\n- **OpenMP:** It handles octree construction (tasks), area and center setup, the row exchange, and the hash reduction.\n- **CMake:** The `.cpp` is compiled as CUDA, since you asked for no new files. MPI, OpenMP and cudart are required, and the CUDA architecture defaults to `native`.\n\n**One semantic change you should know about.** The original draws its Monte-Carlo ray samples from one sequential `mt19937` stream, which can't be split across threads or ranks. I replaced it with a counter-based RNG keyed on the (i, j) pair. Results are therefore the same for any number of ranks, threads or GPUs, but they are not bit-identical to the original in general.\n\n**Verification**\n- **Matches the original:** Result hashes were identical to the original for `-n 320`, `-n 80 -t 31 -s 3`, and `-n 1280 -t 50`. The 1280 run also gave the same validation output and the same non-zero form-factor count, on 1 and 4 ranks.\n- **Does not match:** `-n 320 -t 200 -s 7 -r 0.5` gave a different distance sum (4362 vs 4326). I attribute that to the different random samples, not to a bug, but I didn't isolate the cause.\n- **Not compared:** I didn't run the original on 5120 or 20480 triangles. The new code ran both, and 20480 triangles with 100 timesteps on 4 ranks took about 5.2 s in total.\n- **Speed at 1280 triangles:** On 1 rank the new code took 222 ms, against about 1.5 s for the original's 320-triangle precompute alone. On 4 ranks it took 17 ms.\n\n**Limitation.** The propagation step assumes every delay is at least 1 timestep. That holds for the icosphere mesh because triangle centers never coincide."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":962,"cache_read_input_tokens":70039,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":962},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"509f5fab-da17-4ab7-a905-e4738cfb0c17","uuid":"8b55948c-d4dd-4053-bc42-500d777bc47f","timestamp":"2026-10-14T23:44:15.283Z","request_id":"req_011Cg31zisMnav11CPPBDJij"}

Each rank holds only its slice of the Kij and delay table. Each timestep's radiosity row is shared with `MPI_Allgather`, and distances are gathered the same way. Only rank 0 prints.\n- **CUDA:** There are four kernels:\n  - Form factors and delays: one thread per triangle pair, with an iterative ray test over a flattened octree.\n  - Propagation: one warp per row.\n  - Time-series extraction.\n  - Cross-correlation: one block per triangle. The summation order matches the original and ties go to the smallest lag.\n- **OpenMP:** It handles octree construction (tasks), area and center setup, the row exchange, and the hash reduction.\n- **CMake:** The `.cpp` is compiled as CUDA, since you asked for no new files. MPI, OpenMP and cudart are required, and the CUDA architecture defaults to `native`.\n\n**One semantic change you should know about.** The original draws its Monte-Carlo ray samples from one sequential `mt19937` stream, which can't be split across threads or ranks. I replaced it with a counter-based RNG keyed on the (i, j) pair. Results are therefore the same for any number of ranks, threads or GPUs, but they are not bit-identical to the original in general.\n\n**Verification**\n- **Matches the original:** Result hashes were identical to the original for `-n 320`, `-n 80 -t 31 -s 3`, and `-n 1280 -t 50`. The 1280 run also gave the same validation output and the same non-zero form-factor count, on 1 and 4 ranks.\n- **Does not match:** `-n 320 -t 200 -s 7 -r 0.5` gave a different distance sum (4362 vs 4326). I attribute that to the different random samples, not to a bug, but I didn't isolate the cause.\n- **Not compared:** I didn't run the original on 5120 or 20480 triangles. The new code ran both, and 20480 triangles with 100 timesteps on 4 ranks took about 5.2 s in total.\n- **Speed at 1280 triangles:** On 1 rank the new code took 222 ms, against about 1.5 s for the original's 320-triangle precompute alone. On 4 ranks it took 17 ms.\n\n**Limitation.** The propagation step assumes every delay is at least 1 timestep.
